title: Congress approves extension of fuel support for artisanal fishing until December

Congress approves extension of fuel support for artisanal fishing until December
Chile's Congress has extended monthly fuel subsidies for artisanal fishers through December. The support aims to help small-scale vessel owners cope with higher operational costs due to rising fuel prices.
The National Congress approved on Oct. 8 an extension of economic support for artisanal fishing, continuing the monthly $100,000 contributions to help cover operational costs for small-scale fishing vessels. The measure will remain in effect through December and aims to address rising fuel prices affecting the sector.
The initiative was passed by the Chamber of Deputies and extends monthly payments for October, November, and December to owners of artisanal vessels up to 12 meters in length registered in the Artisanal Fishing Registry. This decision follows previous months’ support provided through the Artisanal Fishing Coupon program.
According to officials, this approval allows continued backing for nearly 5,000 vessels that benefited as of September. The funds are designated exclusively for purchasing fuel used in vessel operations—a major expense for those engaged in artisanal fishing.
The Undersecretariat of Fisheries and Aquaculture highlighted the importance of maintaining this form of assistance within the Chile Sale Adelante program. They said it supports not only vessel operations but also family economies linked to small-scale fishing activities.
Authorities said this extraordinary measure was implemented specifically to mitigate increased fuel costs impacting extractive activities.
